hypothesis: A validation-threshold-constrained minimum-loss checkpoint rule may retain a checkpoint that satisfies the prespecified melanoma F1, macro-F1, and nevus-recall criteria when global minimum validation loss selects an ineligible epoch. This tests checkpoint selection only; it does not establish that the alternative rule improves generalization.

rule: After each HAM10000 validation epoch, calculate melanoma F1, macro-F1, nevus recall, and validation loss.
An epoch is eligible only when all three frozen success thresholds pass.
Among eligible epochs, retain the checkpoint with the lowest validation loss.
On an exact validation-loss tie, retain the earlier epoch.

If no epoch is eligible after all 25 epochs, mark FAIL_NO_ELIGIBLE_CHECKPOINT, retain the complete training/validation history and empty eligible-epoch record, and do not run test evaluation or claim a successful checkpoint.
single_intervention.checkpoint_load_policy: After training, load only the selected eligible Experiment #5 checkpoint for final validation and test evaluation. No prior experiment checkpoint initializes training.

frozen_configuration.initialization: same fresh pretrained initialization policy as Experiment #4; do not initialize from baseline or Experiments #1-#4
frozen_configuration.preprocessing: same processed HAM10000 images and transforms as Experiment #4
frozen_configuration.test_policy: Test evaluation occurs only after eligible checkpoint selection and is evaluation only; never used for selection or tuning.

ph2_policy.external_evaluation: Only after Experiment #5 is finalized and separately approved.

expected_generated_artifacts: best_checkpoint.pt (only if at least one eligible epoch exists)
validation_metrics.json (only if an eligible checkpoint exists)
validation_predictions.csv (only if an eligible checkpoint exists)
test_metrics.json (only after eligible checkpoint is selected)
test_predictions.csv (only after eligible checkpoint is selected)

execution_policy.approved_training_runtime: Google Colab with CUDA Tesla T4
